W03-DA07-S001-concurrency-1.claim: Concurrent affiliate OAuth login can revert a successfully saved profile.
W03-DA07-S001-concurrency-1.failure_scenario: An affiliate edits their profile in an authenticated browser while completing a separate OAuth login in another browser. The OAuth email-only save reads the existing PII first. The profile PUT then saves a new name, address and tax details successfully. The OAuth save subsequently UPSERTs its previously read values for every omitted field, reverting those profile changes. Both requests succeed.
W03-DA07-S001-concurrency-1.evidence: At review SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af, the assigned handler constructs an email-only PiiInput at lines 798-804; the competing profile save is at lines 588-624. In /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/affiliate_pii.rs:331-352, save_affiliate_pii_with_storage_login reads existing fields without a transaction or lock. Lines 365-455 retain that snapshot for omitted fields, and lines 458-488 unconditionally replace all columns during ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE.
W03-DA07-S001-concurrency-1.expected_behavior: The explicit partial-update contract in /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/affiliate_pii.rs:254-259 and 307-312 says omitted fields retain their existing values. Its test at lines 911-935 verifies an email-only update preserves name, tax details and VAT status. Neither serial ordering of these two operations would revert the newly saved non-email fields.
W03-DA07-S001-concurrency-1.countermeasures: The PII primary key prevents duplicate rows but not stale-column replacement. Atomic OAuth-state consumption prevents reuse of one callback state, not a valid login racing with a profile PUT. The affiliate routes in /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:1400-1463 do not serialize these handlers.
